sources: Built from 42 web searches and 27 page reads this run · SI, Yahoo, NBC/Rotoworld, RotoWire, Steelers Depot, DK Network, Athlon, Chicago Sun-Times, Sharp Football, Colts.com, TheRams.com, 49ers Webzone, JetNation, FantasyPros, 4for4, footballdb · ESPN league file and week archives 1–3

tonight.headline: A 50-50 week, decided by Friday's report
body: Week 4 hasn't started. ESPN has you at 125.9 against Aye-Aye's 125.2, a coin flip. Achane is gone and Tuten is in: the lineup as set is 0.8 from the projection lineup.

Nothing needs doing today. Allen, Jefferson and Coker practise for the first time this afternoon; Friday's report decides the flex and both fallbacks, because McLaurin locks at 07:30 Sunday in London.

case.label: The risk
case.body: Three questionable starters: Allen (knee contusion, Chao expects him to play), Jefferson (ankle sprain, clean MRI) and Coker (quad strain, avoided serious injury). Every report says all three play.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A DNP on Wednesday and Thursday for any of them. Then the Friday cards fire.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Decide on Friday's report · before Sun 07:30 Mexico City (London kickoff)
doFirst.title: Flex: Coker over McLaurin, if Friday clears him
doFirst.subtitle: The projection's pick by 0.8. A coin flip, so no thesis, just the projection and a clock.

case.label: The coin flip
case.body: Coker 13.8, McLaurin 13.0: inside the two-point line, where ESPN is right 56% of the time. The rule is to take the projection and write no thesis, so there's no decision-log entry.

case.label: The clock
case.body: McLaurin kicks off at 07:30 Sunday in London and Coker at 18:20. The swap has to be made before 07:30, so it rests on Friday's report, not Sunday's inactives.

case.label: The quarterbacks
case.body: Coker has Bryce Young, QB1 on Carolina's Week 4 depth chart (Yahoo 29 Sep), against Detroit, 4th-most WR points allowed. McLaurin has Marcus Mariota, favoured while Daniels' elbow is assessed (RotoWire 29 Sep).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin outscores Coker. And if Coker is inactive at 16:50 after being started, Kamara takes the flex; Boston can't, he plays Thursday.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · fire on Friday OUT/DOUBTFUL · before Sun 07:30
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is ruled out Friday, McLaurin starts
doFirst.subtitle: Carried. The ankle is a sprain with a clean MRI, so this probably never fires.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Right-ankle sprain, no structural damage; O'Connell said he 'got close' to returning on Sunday and swelling is the issue (Athlon 29 Sep). Today is his first practice.

case.label: The clock
case.body: McLaurin locks at 07:30 Sunday, five hours before Jefferson's inactives at 12:35. A Sunday inactive falls to Coker at WR and Kamara in the flex instead.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and McLaurin scores less than the best bench alternative that week.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · if Allen is ruled out · by Sun 09:30 Mexico City
doFirst.title: If Allen is ruled out: add Kyler Murray, drop Monangai
doFirst.subtitle: Carried. Every report says Allen plays; this is the plan if one says otherwise.

case.label: Allen
case.body: Left-knee contusion. Chao: 'hurt, not injured', no missed time expected (SI 29 Sep); Brady 'never usually concerned' (Bills.com). The Bills practise for the first time today.

case.label: Murray
case.body: A free agent here, so no priority. Minnesota's starter since McCarthy was traded (SI 28 Sep), at home to Miami, 31st in yards per attempt allowed (DK Network). He kicks off 14:05, after Allen's 09:30 check.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Monangai, the sixth back: 10 carries a week behind Swift with no targets in Week 3.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: It fires and Murray scores less than the best free quarterback that week (Darnold, Mariota).

whatWentWrong.title: Both WR fallbacks lock before Sunday's inactives
whatWentWrong.lead: Boston plays Thursday and McLaurin at 07:30 in London. Jefferson's inactives come at 12:35 and Coker's at 16:50, so the real decisions are on Friday's report.

case.label: The tool
case.body: lineup_check.py names Boston as Coker's fallback. It ranks by projection and ignores kickoff; Boston is locked by Thursday night.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The flex card and the Jefferson card both fire on Friday, not Sunday. Kamara (Monday) is the only live fallback after 14:05.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Both receivers practising fully by Friday, and nothing needs to fire.

whatWentWrong.title: Lost 103.8 to 140.6, with 34.1 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Carried from Tuesday. The best lineup from this roster scored 137.9 and would still have lost by 2.7. Three of the gaps were injury exits.

case.label: The archive
case.body: Started 103.8. Best available 137.9: Tuten (17.0) for Achane (1.7), McLaurin (19.7) for Jefferson (5.2), Boston (8.1) for Coker (3.8). Achane, Jefferson and Coker all left injured.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing about Week 3. For Week 4 the lesson is the clock: the flex call has to be made before London.

roster.footnote: No game has kicked off. Matchup tiles use footballdb's points allowed through Week 3 (three games, format unstated): a thin sample. The kicker's tile is dashed, not guessed.

lineupCheck.verdict: Coin flip only: the projection lineup puts Coker (13.8) in the flex over McLaurin (13.0); take it once Coker is cleared, no thesis. Allen, Jefferson and Coker are conditional.

contingencies.if: Ruled out on Friday's report, or inactive at Sun 09:30 CDMX
contingencies.then: No QB on the bench: add Kyler Murray (free agent, MIN, kicks off 14:05) and drop Kyle Monangai

contingencies.if: OUT or DOUBTFUL on Friday's report
contingencies.then: Start Terry McLaurin at WR before Sun 07:30 CDMX, when London locks him. If Jefferson is instead inactive at 12:35, move Coker to WR and Kamara into the FLEX

contingencies.if: Not cleared on Friday → leave McLaurin in the FLEX. If started and inactive at Sun 16:50 CDMX
contingencies.then: Start Alvin Kamara (Monday night) in the FLEX. lineup_check.py names Boston, but he plays Thursday and is locked by then

worthALook.name: Jordan Addison
worthALook.lead: Minnesota's WR1 only for as long as Jefferson sits. A free agent, so no priority cost.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5-90-1 on 9 targets with Jefferson out (Athlon 29 Sep); 22% target share without him against 17% with him (DK Network 28 Sep). Kyler Murray throwing.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 2 and 5 targets in Weeks 1–2 with Jefferson healthy. The role is Jefferson's absence.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Jefferson OUT on Friday's report: add Addison for Monangai, then McLaurin still starts first because he locks earlier.

worthALook.name: Jakobi Meyers
worthALook.lead: Carried: a real role change in Jacksonville, but one game of it. The waiver tool's only RISING line.

case.label: The role
case.body: 8 targets and 19.4 points in Week 3 with Brian Thomas Jr. partly benched for drops (Tuesday's research). No new Jaguars reporting found today.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 and 1 touches in Weeks 1–2. One week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Seven-plus targets again at Cincinnati with Thomas still reduced. Then he beats Boston for the last WR seat.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: ESPN: Pineiro 8.8, Loop 8.8, McPherson 8.0, Fairbairn 9.3 but on waivers until Thu 01:00. No gap worth a move.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Fairbairn clearing unclaimed and a second seat opening; a 0.5 gap alone doesn't justify a move.

doNotChase.lead: The wire's biggest riser, and the fit is wrong.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 7-105-1 on 8 targets vs Detroit with Mason Taylor out; Taylor is week-to-week (Yahoo 29 Sep).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Chem starts one tight end and the flex is RB/WR only. Likely is healthy with 92% route participation.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely on a Giants injury report.

doNotChase.name: Dalton Schultz
doNotChase.lead: Carried. The market is leaving him, and the fit hasn't changed.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One TE slot, no TE flex. Ownership down 5.3 in a day.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Likely ruled out.

waiverAnalysis.summary: One riser, no fallers, from three weeks of data, which is still thin. Meyers' gap is one game of a demotion in Jacksonville; watch, don't add.
